scope.selection: Real, orderable parts stocked by LCSC/JLCPCB, chosen per category by KiCad pinout availability, JLC Basic/Preferred class, and stock. Every MPN the repo already references is included when the catalog stocks it.
scope.not_a_design_approval: Catalog membership is not proof of suitability, regulatory compliance, or a complete design. Validate every selected component against its datasheet, schematic, layout, and operating conditions.

data_policy.price_stock: Price tiers (USD) and stock are LCSC/JLCPCB values from the jlcparts snapshot dated checked_at. They change daily; rerun the scraper before relying on them.
data_policy.specs: Parametric values are distributor-reported (JLCPCB/LCSC catalog), normalized to SI units. They are screening data, not datasheet-verified limits.
data_policy.pins: pin_source 'kicad_symbol' means the MPN matched a KiCad library symbol whose footprint or footprint filter agrees with the catalog package. 'kicad_generic' means a conventional two-terminal or single-row-header symbol. kicad=null means no pinout is known; the electrical verifier reports PIN_UNKNOWN rather than guessing.
data_policy.power: Typical power draw is not in the catalog; parts here carry no power_mw.
data_policy.area: area_mm2 is a nominal package outline, not a courtyard.
